newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - Feb 14.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - Feb 14.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following stories on its front page on Friday:
NEW YORK - The Dow Jones industrial average shattered the 7000 mark as bullish investors pushed the market past another barrier.
WASHINGTON - The new welfare law -- contrary to most predictions -- will dramatically increase federal spending per poor family, according to figures released on Thursday.
WASHINGTON - Washington area counties are preparing to push local cable companies to spend several hundred million dollars to modernise their networks by laying new fiber optic cables.
WASHINGTON - Misguided political considerations have prevented the nation from using powerful, proven weapons to fight the AIDS epidemic, a National Institutes of Health panel concluded.

WASHINGTON - The Justice Department has identified at least 50 criminal cases where evidentiary problems created by questionable forensic analysis at the FBI laboratory may have resulted in improper prosecutions.
ORANGE FARM, South Africa - In this struggling community 25 miles south of Johannesburg, children have become prey reflecting the nation's struggle with crime.
